data.one_liner: A code generator for your assets, fonts, and colors to eliminate string-based APIs.
data.what_it_does: Generates strong-typed Dart classes and properties from pubspec.yaml asset paths, colors, and fonts. It provides compile-time safety and prevents typos when accessing application assets.
use_when: You want compile-time safety for your asset paths, fonts, and colors.
You want to avoid using raw strings like 'assets/images/logo.png' throughout your codebase.
avoid_when: You prefer dynamic asset loading or runtime string-based asset paths.
Your project does not use code generation tools.
strengths: Integrates well with popular packages like flutter_svg, lottie, and rive.
weaknesses: Requires running code generation (build_runner) when assets change.
Adds a build step and dependency footprint to the project.
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner and flutter_gen_runner to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml, configure flutter_gen options, and run build_runner.
